'When this hits a hero, if this has {p} greater than its base, they discard a card.' Guardian Action - Attack, so TRIGGERED + ON_HIT (an Action - Attack is never an ATTACK_REACTION). Yellow printing, identical text to the red sibling .drafts/concuss_red.json, whose shape this copies - no amount differs between printings.

RELEASE NOTE 1 ('does not trigger if you hit anything other than a hero') = ability-level ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate - false when combat.attack_target is set (permanent/ally target), true for hero attacks (condition_types.py:1960-1977).

RELEASE NOTE 2 ('{p} is checked on the resolution of the trigger, not when Concuss hits a hero') = ability-level conditions, which the interpreter evaluates at RESOLUTION before effects run; ATTACK_POWER_GT_BASE (condition_types.py:499-509) reads combat.attack_power vs base_attack_power live at that moment, so pumps applied between hit and resolution are seen, exactly as ruled. It reads no parameters.

RELEASE NOTE 3 ('if they have two or more cards in their hand, they choose which card to discard') = DISCARD's default path: non-random discard lets THE DISCARDING PLAYER choose, so the defender picks from their own hand. Handler (effect_types.py:1251+) READS amount/player/random/filter; 'they' maps through player DEFENDING -> opponent of the controller. An empty or one-card hand degrades safely (discards what exists / nothing).

No printed keywords on this card, so no conditional-keyword concern. No gaps; every clause expressible.
